product_one_liner.value: Gushwork uses AI agents to research, create, publish and optimize online content and generate qualified inbound leads for small and mid-sized businesses, especially manufacturers, industrial distributors and commercial-service companies.

employee_band.notes: Based on the reported employee count of 203; the same profile also displays the broader, inconsistent company-size label of 51–200.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies San Francisco as headquarters and Lewes as an additional office.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents AI-search, SEO and lead-generation marketing guides, not two engineer-authored posts explaining how Gushwork is built.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, developer portal or multi-article help center is linked in the inspected navigation or site index.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official board lists Forward Deployed Engineer, Implementation Engineer and Talent Acquisition Partner - GTM; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI; its AI Search Grader also names GPT-4 and proprietary evaluation models.
model_provider.notes: The CEO explicitly describes heavy use of Anthropic models and use of OpenAI models; the product blog identifies the grader’s models.

compliance_certs.notes: No completed certification among the requested five is claimed on the inspected legal pages. GDPR legal-basis and privacy-rights language is not a certification claim.

raised_18mo.notes: The $9 million seed announcement is dated 2026-02-26, within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive - US Sales posting and its application form remain publicly available, although the role is not shown in the abbreviated board listing.

launched_6mo.notes: AI Editor launched on 2026-06-02: customers can update landing pages with plain-English prompts directly from the dashboard.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete, dated executive roster was available to establish a negative, and no qualifying C-level or VP-level appointment or departure could be verified within 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Job-posting signals only: the AE role requests CRM proficiency in Zoho, HubSpot or Salesforce, and the SDR role names HubSpot, Salesforce and JustCall as advantageous familiarity; this is not definitive proof of deployment.
